translations.kjv: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
translations.ylt: Paul and Timotheus, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are in Philippi, with overseers and ministrants;
translations.web: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

translations.kjv: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: Grace to you, and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
translations.web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
translations.ylt: I give thanks to my God upon all the remembrance of you,
translations.web: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

translations.kjv: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
translations.ylt: always, in every supplication of mine for you all, with joy making the supplication,
translations.web: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

translations.kjv: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
translations.ylt: for your contribution to the good news from the first day till now,
translations.web: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

translations.kjv: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
translations.ylt: having been confident of this very thing, that He who did begin in you a good work, will perform it till a day of Jesus Christ,
translations.web: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.
translations.ylt: according as it is righteous for me to think this in behalf of you all, because of my having you in the heart, both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the good news, all of you being fellow-partakers with me of grace.
translations.web: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

translations.kjv: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: For God is my witness, how I long for you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ,
translations.web: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

translations.kjv: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
translations.ylt: and this I pray, that your love yet more and more may abound in full knowledge, and all judgment,
translations.web: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

translations.kjv: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;
translations.ylt: for your proving the things that differ, that ye may be pure and offenceless--to a day of Christ,
translations.web: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

translations.kjv: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.
translations.ylt: being filled with the fruit of righteousness, that is through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
translations.web: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

translations.kjv: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
translations.ylt: And I wish you to know, brethren, that the things concerning me, rather to an advancement of the good news have come,
translations.web: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

translations.kjv: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;
translations.ylt: so that my bonds have become manifest in Christ in the whole praetorium, and to the other places--all,
translations.web: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

translations.kjv: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
translations.ylt: and the greater part of the brethren in the Lord, having confidence by my bonds, are more abundantly bold--fearlessly to speak the word.
translations.web: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

translations.kjv: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
translations.ylt: Certain, indeed, even through envy and contention, and certain also through good-will, do preach the Christ;
translations.web: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

translations.kjv: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
translations.ylt: the one, indeed, of rivalry the Christ do proclaim, not purely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds,
translations.web: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

translations.kjv: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
translations.ylt: and the other out of love, having known that for defence of the good news I am set:
translations.web: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

translations.kjv: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.
translations.ylt: what then? in every way, whether in pretence or in truth, Christ is proclaimed--and in this I rejoice, yea, and shall rejoice.
translations.web: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

translations.kjv: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
translations.ylt: For I have known that this shall fall out to me for salvation, through your supplication, and the supply of the Spirit of Christ Jesus,
translations.web: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

translations.kjv: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.
translations.ylt: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, and in all freedom, as always, also now Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether through life or through death,
translations.web: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

translations.kjv: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
translations.ylt: for to me to live is Christ, and to die gain.
translations.web: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

translations.kjv: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
translations.ylt: And if to live in the flesh is to me a fruit of work, then what shall I choose? I know not;
translations.web: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

translations.kjv: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
translations.ylt: for I am pressed by the two, having the desire to depart, and to be with Christ, for it is far better,
translations.web: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

translations.kjv: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
translations.ylt: and to remain in the flesh is more necessary on your account,
translations.web: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

translations.kjv: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
translations.ylt: and of this being persuaded, I have known that I shall remain and continue with you all, to your advancement and joy of the faith,
translations.web: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

translations.kjv: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.
translations.ylt: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence again to you.
translations.web: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

translations.kjv: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
translations.ylt: Only worthily of the good news of the Christ conduct ye yourselves, that, whether having come and seen you, whether being absent I may hear of the things concerning you, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one soul, striving together for the faith of the good news,
translations.web: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

translations.kjv: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
translations.ylt: and not terrified in anything by those opposing, which to them indeed is a token of destruction, and to you of salvation, and that from God;
translations.web: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

translations.kjv: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
translations.ylt: because to you it was granted, on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also on behalf of him to suffer;
translations.web: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

translations.kjv: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
translations.ylt: the same conflict having, such as ye saw in me, and now hear of in me.
translations.web: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.

translations.kjv: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
translations.ylt: If, then, any exhortation is in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
translations.web: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

translations.kjv: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
translations.ylt: fulfil ye my joy, that ye may mind the same thing--having the same love--of one soul--minding the one thing,
translations.web: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

translations.kjv: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
translations.ylt: nothing in rivalry or vain-glory, but in humility of mind one another counting more excellent than yourselves--
translations.web: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

translations.kjv: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
translations.ylt: each not to your own look ye, but each also to the things of others.
translations.web: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

translations.kjv: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
translations.ylt: For, let this mind be in you that is also in Christ Jesus,
translations.web: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

translations.kjv: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
translations.ylt: who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal to God,
translations.web: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

translations.kjv: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
translations.ylt: but did empty himself, the form of a servant having taken, in the likeness of men having been made,
translations.web: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

translations.kjv: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
translations.ylt: and in fashion having been found as a man, he humbled himself, having become obedient unto death--death even of a cross,
translations.web: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

translations.kjv: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
translations.ylt: wherefore, also, God did highly exalt him, and gave to him a name that is above every name,
translations.web: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

translations.kjv: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;
translations.ylt: that in the name of Jesus every knee may bow--of heavenlies, and earthlies, and what are under the earth--
translations.web: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

translations.kjv: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
translations.ylt: and every tongue may confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
translations.web: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

translations.kjv: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
translations.ylt: So that, my beloved, as ye always obey, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, with fear and trembling your own salvation work out,
translations.web: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

translations.kjv: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
translations.ylt: for God it is who is working in you both to will and to work for His good pleasure.
translations.web: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

translations.kjv: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
translations.ylt: All things do without murmurings and reasonings,
translations.web: Do all things without complaining and arguing,

translations.kjv: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
translations.ylt: that ye may become blameless and harmless, children of God, unblemished in the midst of a generation crooked and perverse, among whom ye do appear as luminaries in the world,
translations.web: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

translations.kjv: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
translations.ylt: the word of life holding forth, for rejoicing to me in regard to a day of Christ, that not in vain did I run, nor in vain did I labour;
translations.web: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

translations.kjv: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
translations.ylt: but if also I am poured forth upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice and joy with you all,
translations.web: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

translations.kjv: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
translations.ylt: because of this do ye also rejoice and joy with me.
translations.web: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

translations.kjv: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
translations.ylt: And I hope, in the Lord Jesus, Timotheus to send quickly to you, that I also may be of good spirit, having known the things concerning you,
translations.web: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

translations.kjv: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
translations.ylt: for I have no one like-minded, who sincerely for the things concerning you will care,
translations.web: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

translations.kjv: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ’s.
translations.ylt: for the whole seek their own things, not the things of the Christ Jesus,
translations.web: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
translations.ylt: and the proof of him ye know, that as a child serveth a father, with me he did serve in regard to the good news;
translations.web: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

translations.kjv: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
translations.ylt: him, indeed, therefore, I hope to send, when I may see through the things concerning me--immediately;
translations.web: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

translations.kjv: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
translations.ylt: and I trust in the Lord that I myself also shall quickly come.
translations.web: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

translations.kjv: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
translations.ylt: And I thought it necessary Epaphroditus--my brother, and fellow-workman, and fellow-soldier, and your apostle and servant to my need--to send unto you,
translations.web: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,

translations.kjv: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.
translations.ylt: seeing he was longing after you all, and in heaviness, because ye heard that he ailed,
translations.web: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.

translations.kjv: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
translations.ylt: for he also ailed nigh to death, but God did deal kindly with him, and not with him only, but also with me, that sorrow upon sorrow I might not have.
translations.web: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

translations.kjv: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
translations.ylt: The more eagerly, therefore, I did send him, that having seen him again ye may rejoice, and I may be the less sorrowful;
translations.web: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

translations.kjv: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
translations.ylt: receive him, therefore, in the Lord, with all joy, and hold such in honour,
translations.web: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,

translations.kjv: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
translations.ylt: because on account of the work of the Christ he drew near to death, having hazarded the life that he might fill up your deficiency of service unto me.
translations.web: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

translations.kjv: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
translations.ylt: As to the rest, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord; the same things to write to you to me indeed is not tiresome, and for you is sure;
translations.web: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

translations.kjv: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
translations.ylt: look to the dogs, look to the evil-workers, look to the concision;
translations.web: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.

translations.kjv: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
translations.ylt: for we are the circumcision, who by the Spirit are serving God, and glorying in Christ Jesus, and in flesh having no trust,
translations.web: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

translations.kjv: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
translations.ylt: though I also have cause of trust in flesh. If any other one doth think to have trust in flesh, I more;
translations.web: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

translations.kjv: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
translations.ylt: circumcision on the eighth day! of the race of Israel! of the tribe of Benjamin! a Hebrew of Hebrews! according to law a Pharisee!
translations.web: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

translations.kjv: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
translations.ylt: according to zeal persecuting the assembly! according to righteousness that is in law becoming blameless!
translations.web: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

translations.kjv: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
translations.ylt: But what things were to me gains, these I have counted, because of the Christ, loss;
translations.web: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

translations.kjv: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
translations.ylt: yes, indeed, and I count all things to be loss, because of the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord, because of whom of the all things I suffered loss, and do count them to be refuse, that Christ I may gain, and be found in him,
translations.web: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

translations.kjv: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
translations.ylt: not having my righteousness, which is of law, but that which is through faith of Christ--the righteousness that is of God by the faith,
translations.web: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

translations.kjv: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
translations.ylt: to know him, and the power of his rising again, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being conformed to his death,
translations.web: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

translations.kjv: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
translations.ylt: if anyhow I may attain to the rising again of the dead.
translations.web: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

translations.kjv: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
translations.ylt: Not that I did already obtain, or have been already perfected; but I pursue, if also I may lay hold of that for which also I was laid hold of by the Christ Jesus;
translations.web: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

translations.kjv: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
translations.ylt: brethren, I do not reckon myself to have laid hold; and one thing--the things behind indeed forgetting, and to the things before stretching forth--
translations.web: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

translations.kjv: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
translations.ylt: to the mark I pursue for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
translations.web: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

translations.kjv: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
translations.ylt: As many, therefore, as are perfect--let us think this, and if in anything ye think otherwise, this also shall God reveal to you,
translations.web: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

translations.kjv: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
translations.ylt: but to what we have come--by the same rule walk, the same thing think;
translations.web: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

translations.kjv: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.
translations.ylt: become followers together of me, brethren, and observe those thus walking, according as ye have us--a pattern;
translations.web: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

translations.kjv: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:
translations.ylt: for many walk of whom many times I told you--and now also weeping tell--the enemies of the cross of the Christ!
translations.web: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

translations.kjv: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
translations.ylt: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who the things on earth are minding.
translations.web: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

translations.kjv: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
translations.ylt: For our citizenship is in the heavens, whence also a Saviour we await--the Lord Jesus Christ--
translations.web: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

translations.kjv: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
translations.ylt: who shall transform the body of our humiliation to its becoming conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working of his power, even to subject to himself the all things.
translations.web: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

translations.kjv: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
translations.ylt: So then, my brethren, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand ye in the Lord, beloved.
translations.web: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

translations.kjv: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
translations.ylt: Euodia I exhort, and Syntyche I exhort, to be of the same mind in the Lord;
translations.web: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

translations.kjv: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.
translations.ylt: and I ask also thee, genuine yoke-fellow, be assisting those women who in the good news did strive along with me, with Clement also, and the others, my fellow-workers, whose names are in the book of life.
translations.web: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

translations.kjv: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
translations.ylt: Rejoice in the Lord always; again I will say, rejoice;
translations.web: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

translations.kjv: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
translations.ylt: let your forbearance be known to all men; the Lord is near;
translations.web: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

translations.kjv: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
translations.ylt: for nothing be anxious, but in everything by prayer, and by supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known unto God;
translations.web: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

translations.kjv: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
translations.ylt: and the peace of God, that is surpassing all understanding, shall guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
translations.web: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

translations.kjv: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
translations.ylt: As to the rest, brethren, as many things as are true, as many as are grave, as many as are righteous, as many as are pure, as many as are lovely, as many as are of good report, if any worthiness, and if any praise, these things think upon;
translations.web: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

translations.kjv: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
translations.ylt: the things that also ye did learn, and receive, and hear, and saw in me, those do, and the God of the peace shall be with you.
translations.web: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

translations.kjv: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.
translations.ylt: And I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at length ye flourished again in caring for me, for which also ye were caring, and lacked opportunity;
translations.web: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

translations.kjv: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
translations.ylt: not that in respect of want I say it, for I did learn in the things in which I am--to be content;
translations.web: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

translations.kjv: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
translations.ylt: I have known both to be abased, and I have known to abound; in everything and in all things I have been initiated, both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in want.
translations.web: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

translations.kjv: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
translations.ylt: For all things I have strength, in Christ's strengthening me;
translations.web: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

translations.kjv: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
translations.ylt: but ye did well, having communicated with my tribulation;
translations.web: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

translations.kjv: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.
translations.ylt: and ye have known, even ye Philippians, that in the beginning of the good news when I went forth from Macedonia, no assembly did communicate with me in regard to giving and receiving except ye only;
translations.web: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

translations.kjv: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.
translations.ylt: because also in Thessalonica, both once and again to my need ye sent;
translations.web: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

translations.kjv: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
translations.ylt: not that I seek after the gift, but I seek after the fruit that is overflowing to your account;
translations.web: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

translations.kjv: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.
translations.ylt: and I have all things, and abound; I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things from you--an odour of a sweet smell--a sacrifice acceptable, well-pleasing to God:
translations.web: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

translations.kjv: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
translations.ylt: and my God shall supply all your need, according to His riches in glory in Christ Jesus;
translations.web: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

translations.kjv: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
translations.ylt: and to God, even our Father, is the glory--to the ages of the ages. Amen.
translations.web: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

translations.kjv: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
translations.ylt: Salute ye every saint in Christ Jesus; there salute you the brethren with me;
translations.web: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

translations.kjv: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Cesar’s household.
translations.ylt: there salute you all the saints, and specially those of Caesar's house;
translations.web: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

translations.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen. It was written to the Philippians from Rome by Epaphroditus.
translations.ylt: the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ is with you all. Amen.
translations.web: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
